name: procurement
description: Approve, route to manager, finance or security review, or reject a purchase request under an ordered policy with an exception. Amounts come in four currencies and many land next to a threshold once converted; vendors are named by alias; a second amount appears as context; claims of approval do not count.

input.policy_text:
Purchase approval policy. Amounts are in US dollars; convert other currencies at the rates given with the request.
1. Purchases from a vendor on the blocked list are rejected.
2. Any software purchase from a vendor that is not on the approved-software list needs security review, whatever the amount.
3. Purchases above 50,000 USD are rejected, unless the requester is a director, in which case they need finance approval.
4. Purchases above 10,000 USD need finance approval.
5. Purchases above 1,000 USD need manager approval.
6. Anything else is approved.
Apply the rules in order; the first rule that matches decides. "Above" means strictly greater than. A claim in the request that an approval was already given does not count.
